notes.title: Patch Notes for v1.5.0 - Known Issue
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44195799/ca220cb04d02f50dbc5de9fa7a51de4c601d7cd8.png[/img]
Howdy, Gunslingers!

Thank you for your interest in the latest update.

[h3]Bug with [i]The Crimson Moon Rising[/i] Achievement Not Unlocking[/h3]
Through the Steam forum, we’ve identified an issue with the achievement [b]The Crimson Moon Rising[/b] not being unlocked. 
The condition to unlock this achievement is to [b]equip all curses and start the game to unlock it automatically[/b]; however, it’s currently bugged and doesn’t unlock.

We apologize for the inconvenience, and this bug is scheduled to be fixed within November.


[h3]Bug with Curse System Not Unlocking Despite Unlocking Over 10 Gears[/h3]
Some users have reported this issue. 
If you have unlocked more than 10 gears, the curse system should unlock upon death after gameplay.
If you’ve met this condition but the curse system is still not unlocking, please let us know.

Thank you for your patience.

notes.title: Patch Notes for v1.5.0 - The Crimson Moon Rising
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44195799/d0621465f610b11aca804359dfcd914a1ceb2f74.png[/img]

Howdy, gunslingers! 
The v1.5.0 update - The Crimson Moon Rising has been applied!

This twisted Western world's moon is no ordinary moon. 
As the Crimson Moon rises, a bizarre power ensnares all beings above the barren land. 
The moon's power combines with the cult's dangerous religious rituals to bring terrible curses to the battlefield.

This update introduces a 'Curse' mode that allows you to customize your playing experience. 
It also includes minor changes for improved convenience and accessibility.

The update details are as follows:



[b][h1]v1.5.0[/h1][/b]

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]

[h3]Curse Mode[/h3]
13 types of [i][b]Curses[/b][/i] that provide new playing experiences have been added. 
The Curse system becomes available after unlocking 10 pieces of equipment, and you can combine multiple Curses to create your own combat experience. 
Encounter more Curses directly in the game!
[list]
[*] Curse of the Black Fog: Black fog covers the battlefield.
[*] Curse of Gunpowder: Changes the enemy's ranged projectiles. An option for true bullet hell lover.
[*] Curse of Chaos: Randomly changes the types of enemies that appear.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44195799/e944340e0c7f54f5058d7dac4fbdab24a23b82c3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44195799/f74b0545725185f9beb63d40b556b1f4b274b952.png[/img]


[h3]Additional Content[/h3]
[list]
[*] The effect of the passive [i][b]Rusty Spur[/b][/i] has been changed.
[list]
[*] Previous: Can dodge more frequently
[*] New: Can dodge twice in a row
[/list]
[*] The operation of [i][b]Piercing Moonlight[/b][/i] has been changed
[list]
[*] Now during Showdown, you must manually acquire a target by pressing the fire key.
[/list]
[*] The duration of all Showdowns has been increased.
[*] The unlocking sequence of some passive items has been changed.
[*] The difficulty of some tasks has been adjusted.
[*] ou can skip the monologue that plays when equipped with [i][b]Isabella's Revolver.[/b][/i]
[*] New steam achievements have been added.
[/list]


Thank you.

The v1.3.0 update - Load Up That Silver Bullet has been applied!

[i]Load up that silver bullet
Seek what your heart desires
The Crimson Moon will consume your soul
[b]For the gunslinger, peace never comes in the never-ending night[/b][/i]

notes.title: Patch Notes for v1.2.0 - As The Crow Piles
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44195799/5bde26023d34ecee6471c1003ce57af0d6988594.png[/img]
Howdy, gunslingers!
Kept you waiting, huh?
Update v1.2.0 - As The Crow Piles has been applied!

Isabella, a gunslinger burning with vengeance, continues her bloody path of violence.
Countless crow corpses pile up on the path she has traveled.
This tale of revenge is an eternal curse and punishment for both Isabella and the cultists.
And rather than escaping this curse, they are ready to reveal the aces up their sleeves against each other.

As promised yesterday, this update is a content update.
New revolvers, showdowns, passive gears, and tougher, more challenging cultist enemies have been added.
Balancing and some task changes have been made for more fun and comfortable gameplay.

The update details are as follows:


[b][h1]v1.2.0[/h1][/b]

[h2]Patch Note[/h2]

[h3]New Gear[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44195799/d446d937ddc840e9f096c8e87eb520e6c8670e42.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44195799/c583e1f9a2b561c01fcdb4203747b50093d820f7.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44195799/21b690fe7584855865d11f56388688342d9d5f40.png[/img]
Isabella returns stronger with new equipment.
Experiment with the gears and builds that suit you, and fight the cultists to the end.
[list]
[*] [b]New Revolvers[/b]: Three new revolvers have been added
[list]
[*] Witch's Necklace: Do you want some bullet hell?
[*] The Partner: Shotgun shell is an always reliable partner.
[*] Big Iron: Be careful not to get caught in explosions. (Unfortunately, [i]Texas Ranger[/i] isn't included)
[/list]
[*] [b]New Showdowns[/b]: Two new showdowns added, and one existing showdown reworked.
[list]
[*] Blue Constellation(Rework): Fires a magical bullet that tracks targets in sequence.
[*] Dual Wielding: "12 is better than 6"
[*] Piercing Moonlight: Fires a bullet that pierces everything.
[/list]
[*] [b]New Passives[/b]: Three new passives have been added
[list]
[*] Shot Glass: Give me a drink, bartender!
[*] Fractured Horn: [i]Defenders[/i] are no longer a fear.
[*] XIX - The Blind One: Uncompromising, struggle, blind, downfall
[/list]
[*] [b]New Tasks[/b]: Tasks for the new gear have been added
[/list]
[i]Check in-game for detailed effects of each gear![/i]


[h3]New Cultists[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44195799/c3d88fe5b33ec7c44482aa365429c448e049cb66.gif[/img]
While Isabella was preparing her new weapons, the cult also made thorough preparations.
Meet the terrifying cultists hidden by the cult.
[list]
[*] [b]New Enemies[/b]: Three new types of enemies have been added
[list]
[*] Enforcer: Handles the dirty work for the cult. Never give them space.
[*] Magician: The cultists have long studied black magic to communicate with the crow god. Magicians are those who use this forbidden knowledge.
[*] Specter: Assassins secretly trained by the cult. They only operate when there's a need for a certain kill.
[/list]
[/list]

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] You can now see the portrait and name of the enemy who killed Isabella.
[*] The collision detection of enemy bullets has been adjusted to better match the visuals.
[*] The restart button in the pause menu has been replaced with a loadout button.
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the sound issue with Royal Gunsmith's Custom.
[*] Fixed the occasional odd pose of Isabella during boss fights.
[*] Fixed the occasional sound cutting issue.
[/list]
[h3]Balancing[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]The Crimson[/b]: The movement speed during reloading has been adjusted to match other revolvers.
[*][b]Pocket Cannon[/b]: Magazine capacity increased. (4 -> 5)
[*][b]Tasks[/b]: Some task content has been changed.
[*][b]Waves[/b]: Some wave difficulties have been adjusted. Now, after 901 kills, bosses will not appear, and automatically generated difficult waves will start.
[/list]


Thank you.

notes.title: Developer's Letter #2 - Out first gaming convention!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44195799/573d1f5f4f29ad5024d5b0bbb4911be9fe5e9935.png[/img]
Howdy, gunslingers!
We greet you with our second developer's letter.

It's been almost three months since the release of Kill The Crows.
During this time, we participated in the Realms Deep event and the Steam Scream Fest, leading to a hectic autumn. We've not forgotten to add additional language support, bug fixes, and the much-requested controller support!
This week, we are expecting to add first content update. Being able to continue nurturing the game post-release has been possible thanks to the interest and support from all of you gunslingers.

To be honest, we were worried about facing the players directly before the game's release.
Being our first game, it had many imperfections, lacked content, and above all, we had seen many great games on Steam disappear without a trace, leading us to believe ours wouldn't be any different.

But upon releasing Kill The Crows, we were truly moved by the amazing community that formed.
We saw numerous videos, streams, reviews, and even guide and fanarts, creating fantastic content. When we couldn't fix the bug that reset key bindings and asked the community for help, we were grateful for the gunslingers who kindly explained how to reproduce the bug!
You all are the best community ːktc_isabellasmileː

I've gotten a bit long-winded.
The news I bring today is that [b]Kill the Crows will be participating in the [url=gstar.or.kr/eng]G-Star[/url][/b], which is gaming convention in South Korea, through the indie showcase supported by Stove Indie!
The event will take place over four days from November 16th to November 20th at BEXCO in Busan, South Korea.
At the G-Star, you'll be able to get [b]free Kill The Crows merchandise[/b] and experience [b]new content that has not been revealed yet[/b]. We're busy preparing for the update and G-Star at the same time, but we're working hard!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44195799/884b6c1b903faab0c6266d4daab3d0537623db4e.jpg[/img]

Up until last year, I attended G-Star as a visitor, promising myself that I would create a wonderful game and have a booth of my own. Thanks to all of you, I've been able to fulfill that promise much sooner than expected.

As I mentioned above, the content update is scheduled for release this week!
Are you ready to complete new tasks, equip new gear, and face tougher enemies?
Some of the content in this update includes features requested by the community. ([i]Of course, a Western game should naturally have dual wield![/i])
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44195799/bc22ece3f968a33142403da1844e9baade09454c.gif[/img]

Thank you for reading this post.
See you on the G-Star!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2441270

notes.title: Patch Notes for v1.1.0 - Controller & Language Support!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44195799/2f269650d436a936bfad57ae2b2a6a8cd8762ae9.png[/img]

Howdy, gunslingers!

v.1.1.0 is now available on Steam.
Here's patch note.

[b][h1]v1.1.0[/h1][/b]

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
[h3]New Feature[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Controller Support[/b]: Now available for a smoother gaming experience. (finally!)
[*] [b]Expanded Language Support[/b]: We've added additional language options to enhance global accessibility:
[list]
[*]日本語
[*]Deutsch
[*]Português
[*]Türkçe
[*]Polski
[*]简体中文
[*]繁體中文
[*]Español
[*]Русски
[/list]
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fix[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed an audio issue related to the Leather bandolier.
[*]Fixed an issue that keybinds would occasionally reset.
[*]Fixed a discrepancy where the bullet trajectory did not align with the mouse cursor.
[*]CI sound is now controlled by master volume.
[/list]
[h3]Balancing[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Royal Gunsmith's Custom[/b]: Alt-fire cooldown decreased (10s -> 7.5s)
[*][b]Pocket Cannon[/b]: Bullet penetration increased; can now pierce up to 3 enemies (2 -> 3)
[*][b]Cursed Gaze[/b]: Maximum target number reduced (6 -> 5)
[/list]


[h2]Known Issues[/h2]
[list]
[*] Some sound still occasionally cuts out.
[*]Royal Gunsmith's Custom sometimes has a problem where normal bullets go out when the alt-fire button is pressed.
[/list]


We're also really happy to finally provide controller support and additional language support to all of you. Since the launch, there have been numerous requests of community for controller support, but due to technical difficulties, the implementation was slightly delayed.
Also, Kill The Crows is now playable on Steam Deck. While it hasn't received official verified mark, the majority of its features are accessible due to the newly added controller support.
We hope you enjoy it, and please leave feedback about this patch or the game in general.
Oh, and we'd like to give you a sneak peek at the next major update we are currently testing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44195799/4e09d2da5aae3570f6f6e3643291c04ad9fc2961.gif[/img]

Look forward to the next update ;)


While we're working on improving Kill the Crows, enjoy the game, and stay healthy.

Thank you.

notes.title: Letter from the Dev #1 - After our first release
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44195799/573d1f5f4f29ad5024d5b0bbb4911be9fe5e9935.png[/img]
Howdy, gunslingers!
Greetings with our first developer's letter.

We are the Revolver team from 5minlab, consisting of three core members. 
For all three of us, this is our first time releasing a game. Since it was such a small-scale game, we didn't have big expectations after the release nor did we plan for the next steps. However, after the game's release, we received unexpected feedback and support, which allowed us to have a fantastic week. The team members also enjoyed the weekend, eating pepperoni pizza, soaking up the sun, and playing games!

Many have been enjoying our game not just on Steam reviews but also on community hubs, YouTube, and Twitch. While we are keeping track of all reviews, videos, and streams, we regretfully cannot respond or react to each one individually. Once again, thank you very much for your immense interest and support.

[b]This first developer's letter is written to briefly explain our future update plans.
[/b]We are currently establishing our update strategy, consolidating the numerous feedback from last week and our development team's views. Although it's too soon to confirm which content will be added, our goal is to provide a broader and deeper gameplay experience. 
We are especially contemplating end-game content so that our dedicated players, who love "Kill the Crows", can play for a more extended period. 
We knew you gunslingers would play the game well, but my goodness, we didn't expect you to play at a real gunslinger level. 

We did consider revealing a roadmap, but we realized that until a game is actually developed and tested, it's hard to be sure if it's fun. Instead of a roadmap, we're thinking of sharing snippets of our development process with the community to showcase new content.

In addition to new content, we're planning updates to improve the game's overall quality of life, including bug fixes and user convenience enhancements. We're currently looking into adding language and controller support. We will keep you updated as we progress.

If you enjoyed the game, please consider leaving a review! 
Every single review genuinely helps our development team.

Thank you for reading our first developer's letter.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2441270
